headline: Hindalco reappoints Satish Pai as MD while Nasscom seeks AI scheme in Budget 2027-28

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Hindalco Industries reappointed Satish Pai as Managing Director and named Hemant Sikka as deputy MD.
Nasscom advocated for a three-year AI Transformation Scheme in the Budget for 2027-28.
FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri, leading the brand to emphasize its water safety measures.
Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and board director following recent executive changes.
whatHappening: Hindalco announced leadership continuity with Satish Pai continuing as MD.
Nasscom submitted key AI budget recommendations to accelerate national AI deployment.
FSSAI legal actions against Bisleri brought focus onto food and beverage safety standards.
International tech sentiment reacted to Jensen Huang's immediate reinstatement at Nvidia.
summary:
Hindalco announced key executive leadership updates, reappointing Satish Pai as MD.
Nasscom urged government support for a three-year AI Transformation Scheme in Budget 2027-28.
FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against packaged water firm Bisleri over safety standards.
